caseName: Provision Salesmen & Distributors Union, Local 627 v. United States
caseNameFull: PROVISION SALESMEN & DISTRIBUTORS UNION, LOCAL 627, AMALGAMATED MEAT CUTTERS & BUTCHER WORKMEN OF NORTH AMERICA, AFL-CIO v. UNITED STATES Et Al.
attorneys: Louis Waldman and Seymour M. Waldman for appellant., Solicitor General Griswold and Assistant Attorney General Zimmerman for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. United Mine Workers of America v. Pennington, 381 U. S. 657; American Federation of Musicians v. Carroll, 391 U. S. 99; and Los Angeles Meat Drivers Union v. United States, 371 U. S. 94.

Mr. Justice Stewart is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
